follow-up time: Until harness success or failure (mean 18.5 days)
cohort: 39 consecutive patients with an Ortolani-positive hip treated initially with a Pavlik harness
finding: The Pavlik harness failed to reduce and stabilize the hip in 20.5% of newborns with an Ortolani-positive hip, with multigravida and foot deformity being statistically associated with failure.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was not significantly associated with Pavlik harness failure (p = 0.394).
